subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: For identical assessment, policy version, selected harness, role, override, and qualification evidence, routing resolution shall produce the same result using zero model inference and zero network I/O; after every terminal result exists and before task claim or selected worker/reviewer invocation, the runtime shall durably append that terminal to the configured canonical git evidence store and exact-read it successfully. The append and exact-read are the only network operations permitted in that interval: no policy lookup, qualification lookup, harness probe, model call, or other outbound operation may occur.
fit_criterion: repeated and reordered-input fixtures are byte-identical; the offline resolution suite records zero inference and zero network I/O through the terminal result; every healthy-path boundary trace contains a successful canonical append and exact-read before claim or invocation and no other network operation; a zero-evidence healthy path fails, and unavailable or unverifiable evidence produces zero claim and zero worker/reviewer invocation
